story: Nia borrowed the little drum from Dalia, and she hoped to play a duet with Mateo. Nia said, “I need an answering beat.” Mateo said, “I am not ready for the audience.” Nia said, “I choose to perform a solo.” Nia practiced a soft beat and a loud beat. Nia performed the solo on the little drum before Dalia. Mateo clapped, and Nia bowed.
